packageRules.description: Frozen. druxt_docs computes the table of contents with a PHP port of github-slugger 1.5.0, and the import fails when the two disagree. Move both together, by hand.
The root lint tooling is held at the last versions that run on Node 16.20.1, the Node Nuxt 2 builds with. Move it with the Node upgrade, not before.
Majors need a human. An automated major lands a breaking change on a branch nobody chose to upgrade.
One pull request for everything else. Ungrouped updates produce a pull request per dependency, and the whole set gets ignored together.
